root_cause.trigger: %banner-separator payload PC 72 has a relative -64 backedge to PC 8 while the current streamed window begins at PC 43
root_cause.mechanism: The old OP_JMPREL/OP_JFALSEREL implementation performed ip += delta directly. The backedge therefore formed code - 35, a C pointer outside vm_codebuf, before later pointer subtraction attempted to recover the logical PC. That arithmetic is undefined C behavior and the MOS/LTO product misexecuted it as a bad opcode.
root_cause.why_host_oracles_were_green: The host happened to recover the wrapped logical offset and ASAN/UBSAN did not diagnose pointer formation/subtraction without an out-of-bounds dereference. The product target did not preserve that accidental behavior.

bounded_correction.implementation: Compute every relative target in the uint16 logical payload-PC domain, reject targets outside the payload, and either move within the current window or invalidate the window so WIN_ENSURE reloads the target. Never form an out-of-array C pointer.
permanent_evidence: explicit cross-window backward-edge source gate with a mutation that restores direct pointer-relative dispatch
full capacity and structural gates on any separately authorized successor product link

separate_performance_first_red.next_evidence: Measure calls and bytes by phase before proposing any batching or cache seam. No performance acceptance is inherited from Link 25.
